text: Cervélo is one of the bicycle brands in Pon's portfolio.
short: Cervélo is one of Pon's bicycle brands.

source.name: Pon: About us
source.quote: Our portfolio includes premium and high-end leading bicycle brands like Gazelle, Cannondale, Kalkhoff, Urban Arrow, Caloi, Santa Cruz, Schwinn, Mongoose, Veloretti and Cervélo.
source.note: Pon's own company page for the brand (https://www.pon.com/en/companies/cervelo) also notes (in Dutch): 'Geen wonder dat Cervélo hoofdsponsor is van Team Visma | Lease a Bike' — 'No wonder Cervélo is main sponsor of Team Visma | Lease a Bike'.
